task: tpl mini template engine: variables, filters, if/elif/else, for with loop vars, HTML escaping, whitespace control, line/column errors
reasoning_summary: Split parsing into a raw splitter (tags, comments, whitespace control) and a recursive-descent block/expression parser producing a sealed-interface AST; rendering uses a pattern-matching switch with an immutable scope chain. Every error carries 1-based line/column via a Source offset map. One bug found by tests: a stale 'stop' tag leaked out of nested blocks so an unclosed outer block went undetected.
